Class PreparationScope.Job<T>

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.PreparationScope.Job<T>

T - immutable result type
All Implemented Interfaces:

Enclosing class:

public final class PreparationScope.Job<T> extends Object implements AutoCloseable
One preparation result. Completion is observational; cleanup never claims to undo published data.

    • deliver

      public PreparationScope.Job<T> deliver(Executor executor, BiConsumer<? super T, ? super Throwable> callback)
      Delivers once on the supplied executor only if this job remains the slot's current owner.
      Parameters:
      executor - target thread scheduler (for example, Minecraft's scheduled task bridge)
      callback - result or error; exceptions are logged without preventing other cleanup
      Returns:
      this handle for retention
